But the claims are not opposite: 182 says the world exists because of the selfless, and 194 says it is harsh, so the two are compatible. 182 also does not 'turn it to action'; only 194 ends in counsel ('இனிய காண்க').
Same thurai (குதிரை மறம்), two poets, and the frame 'நோக்கினர்ச் செகுக்கும் காளை' / 'எள்ளுநர்ச் செகுக்கும் காளை' with only the victim slot varied. The teaches states exactly what the pair shows.

27 reports as hearsay that 'புலவர் பாடும் புகழுடையோர் விசும்பின் வலவன் ஏவா வான ஊர்தி எய்துப', and 234 ties earthly fame to honour in 'புத்தேள் உலகு'. The premise fits one reading of the couplet, but 234 is elliptical and its புலவர் is uncertain, so the link depends on that one reading.

The verbal echo is close: 'செற்றார்பின் செல்லாப் பெருந்தகைமை' (1255) answers 'இகழ்வார்பின் சென்று நிலை' (966). As the teaches itself says, 1255 does not deny 966's honour, only says the lovesick cannot know it ('காமநோய் உற்றார் அறிவதொன்று அன்று'). That limits 966, so it is not a tension.

Two poets petitioning Kumanan under the same thurai use the same picture: 'இல்லி தூர்த்த பொல்லா வறுமுலை சுவைத்தொறும் அழூஉம்தன் மகத்துவம்' (164) and 'புதல்வன் ... பாலில் வறுமுலை சுவைத்தனன் பெறாஅன்' (160). That supports reading it as a set argument of the plea rather than a private report.
links.text_issue: 160 has misprint candidates at lines 6, 10, 14, 21 (not in the breast lines).

poems.note: களவன் may be the crab or 'secret partner'; either way the male snail taking others and then uniting with its mate maps onto the hero, the parattai and the wife.

iraicchi.act: kills a stag to end the hunger of its she-dog in the waste
iraicchi.sense: the man who takes her on the road will provide for her as the male feeds his mate, so the friend can urge her to go

poems.note: The anril's call is only a sound in the line; the poem does not say it calls a mate.

iraicchi.act: breaks the striped sand-houses that young girls play in
iraicchi.sense: as the elder-like wave wrecks the girls' play, the elders have shut her in and ended the shore meetings

poems.note: அன்ன joins the wave to elders, so it is half open; tagged as iraicchi since only the act carries the confinement.

ullurai.anchor: அம்பல் வாய்த்த தெய்ய ... எம் அழுங்கல் ஊரே

poems.note: Only two pairs (buffalo to hero, fresh neythal to the girl); borderline.

iraicchi.act: breaks its tusk stripping dry maraa bark to feed its mate in the harsh summer
iraicchi.sense: a male can keep his mate even in the waste, so the man will go only if he takes the girl with him

iraicchi.act: the female monkey frolics with her mate, hands full of jackfruit, in his land
iraicchi.sense: even unschooled monkeys stay together in his country while he has left her, so he should return and keep his vow

poems.note: Guards fencing the young paddy against the old cow map onto the anxious mother and the girl; the cow's counterpart is not fixed.

iraicchi.act: the little hen, not joined with her cock, pines in the thorny nest through the night
iraicchi.sense: the heroine lies sleepless apart from him as the hen does, while he thinks only of his own town

iraicchi.act: the tusker, fearing the yali, holds his trembling pregnant mate safe with his trunk
iraicchi.sense: the man should have been beside her through the cold season as the tusker shields its mate, yet he left and did not think of her

poems.note: Tusker, yali and she-elephant could be mapped part by part, but the friend's point rests on the pair's one act, so iraicchi.

iraicchi.act: takes the mirage for water and runs after it till it is worn out
iraicchi.sense: the heart's chase of wealth is a thirst for an illusion that leaves the lovers parted for nothing

poems.note: மா is read as 'deer/beast'; the reading is not fixed by the Tamil.
Colophon reads தலைமகற்குத் தலைமகன், evidently தலைமகள்.
